BETA Close X Currys Plc has announced the purchase of 1,177,549 of its own ordinary shares for cancellation between July 28, 2026, and August 3, 2026, as part of its ongoing share buy-back program. The average price paid per share was approximately 165.78 pence. Following these transactions, the total number of ordinary shares in issue will be 1,090,736,007, with no shares held in treasury. This figure will serve as the denominator for shareholders calculating their notifiable interests under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
